steps.detail: Start lab cve-001 from its checked-in manifest.
Confirm the expected demo version and localhost binding.
Inspect reflected-output encoding in the isolated XSS demo.
Collect the lab-specific vulnerable and patched verdicts.
Persist logs and stop only the selected lab.

context_summary:
[CWE-79] CWE-79 Improper Neutralization of Input During Web Page Generation ('Cross-site Scripting'): The product does not neutralize or incorrectly neutralizes user-controllable input before it is placed in output that is used as a web page that is served to other users.
[CWE-352] CWE-352 Cross-Site Request Forgery (CSRF): The web application does not, or cannot, sufficiently verify whether a request was intentionally provided by the user who sent the request, which could have originated from an unauthorized actor.
